abilities.name: Broken Veteran
abilities.gameEffect: Until the end of the cycle, allied cogs can coordinate Pétra Kantor regardless of her rank.

abilities.name: Sense of Effort
abilities.gameEffect:
Target an allied cog within 4" of Jana Alena Novak.
It immediately makes a free advance or free melee attack.

abilities.name: The King's Choice
abilities.gameEffect:
Target an enemy cog within 4" of the Queen. That cog chooses one of the following two effects:
• Set all of its stats to 0 until the end of this planning phase.
• Or assign it one Darkness token.

abilities.name: Shadow Dynasty
abilities.gameEffect: Your opponent cannot play a cog activation card during a planning phase in which you reveal Ivo Andrazy.

abilities.name: Configuration Tarot
abilities.gameEffect: During setup, secretly draw the bottom 3 cards of the Artefact deck. Throughout the game, when resolving a Mechanism, you may discard the drawn Artefact card without applying its effects and replace it with one of the 3 cards drawn during setup.

abilities.name: Occult Philanthropist
abilities.gameEffect: At the end of each cycle, enemy cogs within 2" of Madame Fugger that have 2 Darkness tokens are considered corrupt.

abilities.name: Intimidation
abilities.gameEffect: During a planning phase in which you reveal Victor Goran, enemy cogs cannot target Victor Goran with an attack.

abilities.name: Superstitious
abilities.gameEffect: During the activation of an allied cog, if this planning phase benefited from a Mechanism, you may reassign up to 1{action} to Robert Kadlec and activate him.

abilities.name: Echo of the Jizni Squad
abilities.gameEffect:
Assign a Bile token to your reserve.
Then assign 1 action token to Corporal Vlach and each allied cog.

abilities.name: Quantum Flux Detector
abilities.gameEffect: Remove one Darkness token from Kubik Oktobar or from an allied cog within 1" of him.

abilities.name: Discreet
abilities.gameEffect: If Hynek Novotny is revealed simultaneously with an opponent’s Ministry card during the planning phase, it may still be activated.

abilities.name: Dark Appetite
abilities.gameEffect: When the Hunter makes an attack, it gains a +X bonus to its {melee} stat, where X is the number of Darkness tokens on the cog targeted by that attack.

abilities.name: Vitiation
abilities.gameEffect: When Lukas performs an agenda-specific ability that generates at least one Darkness token, he may assign one of those tokens to a cog within 2" of him.

abilities.name: Synchronous Cadence
abilities.gameEffect: If Yago is not stunned and his activation card is revealed, enemy cogs within 2" of him must spend 1 additional {action} token to perform a rest.

abilities.name: No Hygiene, No Reason
abilities.gameEffect: The Vagabond suffers a -X{melee} penalty when making a melee attack, where X is the number of Darkness tokens on the cog targeted by the attack.

abilities.name: One Shot, One Kill
abilities.gameEffect: When Oskar Borgo makes a ranged attack, if his activation card has already been revealed, he may gain a +X bonus to his {ranged} stat, where X is the slot number occupied by his activation card in your planning row.

abilities.name: Suppressive Fire
abilities.gameEffect: During Operator Sikora's next ranged attack, the target cannot dodge.

abilities.name: Industrial Wrench
abilities.gameEffect: Dominik Kralov gains +2{melee} when targeting a stunned cog with a melee attack.

abilities.name: Prophetic Visions
abilities.gameEffect: Each cycle, at the start of planning, before placing your own planning cards, your opponent must place the first card of their planning row face up.

abilities.name: Putrid Influence
abilities.gameEffect:
Target a cog within 4" that has a Darkness token.
Push it toward the Vermin.

abilities.name: Integrity Detergent
abilities.gameEffect: Place the movement gauge in contact with Herman Zofie. All other cogs in contact with the gauge suffer X wounds, where X is the number of Darkness tokens they have. Then remove all Darkness tokens from those cogs.

abilities.name: Under Pressure
abilities.gameEffect: At the start of each cycle, when the action token pools are formed, give Robert Kadlec 2{action} instead of 4.

abilities.name: Kalbélia Dance
abilities.gameEffect: Assign 1{stunned} token to an enemy cog engaged by Maja, then push her.

abilities.name: Selective Cut
abilities.gameEffect: Jakub Myasnik may perform the following combat tactic for 2 successes: mark 1 tainted HP on the health track of the cog targeted by this attack.

abilities.name: Provocation
abilities.gameEffect: Sergo Dragomir gains a +2 bonus to his {melee} stat when making a melee attack against an enemy cog whose activation card has not been revealed.

abilities.name: First-Aid Kit
abilities.gameEffect: At the start of the first cycle, Medic Ruzicka may be equipped with one additional equipment card affiliated with the Ministry of Integrity.

abilities.name: Controlled Movement
abilities.gameEffect:
Target an allied cog within 4" that has a Darkness token.
Remove one Darkness token from it, then push it toward Kalès.

abilities.name: Carapace
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog gains two additional reinforced HP at the start of its health track.

abilities.name: Venal Flattery
abilities.gameEffect: Target a cog within 1" of the equipped cog. Hostile cogs treat it as rank 4 until the end of the cycle.

abilities.name: Stigmata
abilities.gameEffect:
Choose a terrain feature within 1" of the equipped cog.
It becomes tainted until the end of the cycle.

abilities.name: Hushed Whispers
abilities.gameEffect:
Choose a rank 1 or 2 hostile cog within 1" of the equipped cog.
Move it.

abilities.name: Alms
abilities.gameEffect: After resolving a Mechanism, remove one Darkness token from the equipped cog.

abilities.name: Synchronous Caress
abilities.gameEffect: During a planning phase that benefited from a Mechanism, the equipped cog may make a free melee attack.

abilities.name: Pack Mentality
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog gains support from hostile cogs when it targets an enemy cog with a melee attack, or when an enemy cog targets it with a melee attack.

abilities.name: Nocturnal Call
abilities.gameEffect: Resolve a Mechanism.

abilities.name: Ministry of Progress Manual
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog, or an allied cog within 1" of it, will benefit from support on its next {tech} stat roll.

abilities.name: Manifesto of the God-Object
abilities.gameEffect: Immediately after resolving a Mechanism, the equipped cog may make a free advance.

abilities.name: Pheromones
abilities.gameEffect: Hostile cogs treat the equipped cog as being rank 1.

abilities.name: KO Capsule
abilities.gameEffect: Target a cog within 1" of the equipped cog. Increase the difficulty of all its stat rolls by 1 until the end of this planning phase.

abilities.name: Confidential Capsule
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog is worth 1 fewer victory point when taken out of action.

abilities.name: Tetra Union Card
abilities.gameEffect: During a planning phase in which the equipped cog is activated by a propaganda card, it may perform a free melee attack.

abilities.name: Ration
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog may perform a free generic ability.

abilities.name: Lumen
abilities.gameEffect: When an allied cog targets a cog within 4" of the equipped cog with a ranged attack, it does not suffer the range penalty.

abilities.name: High-Velocity Ammunition
abilities.gameEffect: When making a ranged attack, the equipped cog may perform a combat tactic to push the target directly away from the attacker.

abilities.name: Quantum Catalyst
abilities.gameEffect:
Target a tainted cog engaged by the equipped cog.
Remove an action token from it.

abilities.name: Harmonium
abilities.gameEffect: You may recruit a rank 1 or rank 2 cog affiliated with the Ministry of the Axis into your cabal.

abilities.name: Chronograph
abilities.gameEffect: When resolving a Mechanism, you may discard the drawn Artefact card, ignore its effects, and draw a new one.

abilities.name: Mind Enslaver
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog, rank 1 or 2, may be recruited into the Others faction.

abilities.name: Effort Manual
abilities.gameEffect: When the equipped cog is activated through coordination during a planning phase, it may make a free advance.

abilities.name: Stabilising Pills
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog may replace one failure with one success on its next {melee} stat roll.

abilities.name: Integrity Kit
abilities.gameEffect: Heal up to 2 HP on the equipped cog.

abilities.name: Hazmat Suit
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog suffers a -1{melee} penalty. In return, it does not gain any Darkness tokens when performing agenda-specific abilities that generate them.

abilities.name: Demolition Notice
abilities.gameEffect:
Target a terrain feature in contact with the equipped cog that is not an objective terrain feature. From the next cycle until the end of the game, the equipped cog gains the following ability:
{active} {darkness} {freq:game:1} Demolish: All cogs within 2" of the targeted terrain feature suffer 1D3 wounds that ignore protection and become stunned. Then remove that terrain feature from the Block.

abilities.name: Hidden Access Plans
abilities.gameEffect: Choose a terrain feature in contact with the equipped cog. Place the equipped cog within 4" of its current position, in contact with that terrain feature.

abilities.name: Prime Union Card
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog may perform a coordination when activated by a propaganda card.

abilities.name: Devotion Collar
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog may tempt fate without receiving a Darkness token.

abilities.name: Food Supplement
abilities.gameEffect: Reassign 1{action} token to the equipped cog.

abilities.name: Gloom Decoy
abilities.gameEffect: Push all rank 1 or 2 hostile cogs within 4" of the equipped cog toward it.

abilities.name: Brawler's Manual
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog has a {melee} stat value of 3 when making a melee attack against an enemy cog that has no {action} tokens left.

abilities.name: Dissonance Explosive
abilities.gameEffect: After resolving a Mechanism, cogs within 1" of the equipped cog suffer X wounds that ignore protection, where X is the first digit of the number on the revealed Artefact card.

abilities.name: Lemon Balm Dose
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog suffers 1D3 wounds that ignore protection, then may replace X failures with X successes on its next {melee} stat roll, where X is the result of the D3.

abilities.name: Chrono Dose
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog suffers 1D3 wounds that ignore protection, then push the equipped cog X times, where X is the result of the D3.

abilities.name: Diktat Manual
abilities.gameEffect: You may place your Ministry card without having to use the slot matching its planning constraint.

abilities.name: Census Pass
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog cannot be targeted by an attack of opportunity.

abilities.name: Dogma Manual
abilities.gameEffect: When you must resolve the effect of one of your Ministry cards, you may resolve the fallen Ministry's effect instead.

abilities.name: Bug
abilities.gameEffect: At the start of planning each cycle, before placing your own planning cards, you may force your opponent to place one of their propaganda cards face up in their planning row.

abilities.name: Liturgical Loudspeaker
abilities.gameEffect: When the equipped cog performs a rest, it may target an allied cog within 4".

abilities.name: Harmony Manual
abilities.gameEffect: When the equipped cog tempts fate on a {tech} stat roll, it rerolls only failures.

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.gameEffect: When the equipped cog is targeted by a ranged attack, reduce the attacking cog's {ranged} stat value by 1.

abilities.name: Contraband Rifle
abilities.gameEffect: The equipped cog has a {tech} stat value of 0 and a {ranged} stat value of 5.

abilities.name: Bomb
abilities.gameEffect:
Target an agenda marker in contact with the equipped cog.
From the next cycle until the end of the game, the equipped cog gains the following ability:
{active} {darkness} {freq:game:1} Detonate: All cogs within 2" of the targeted marker suffer 1D3 wounds that ignore protection and become stunned.

abilities.name: “On Our Lives”
abilities.gameEffect: When building your cabal, replace your propaganda card with the “On Our Lives” card. Until the end of the game, this propaganda card is not blocked by opposing Ministries.

abilities.name: Borovice Grenade
abilities.gameEffect: When targeted by a melee attack, the equipped cog may use the Borovice grenade instead of dodging or making a counter attack. If it does, cancel all successes on the attacker's stat roll, then push the attacker.

abilities.name: Construction Barrier
abilities.gameEffect:
If there is no allied barrier marker (30 mm base) on the Block, place one within 1" of the equipped cog. This marker is considered a non-blocking terrain feature. All cogs (including the equipped cog) gain the following ability until the end of the game:
{active} {action} Destroy: Target a barrier marker within 1" and remove it from the Block.

abilities.name: Response Siren
abilities.gameEffect: A cog engaged by the equipped cog cannot coordinate or be coordinated.

abilities.name: Concussive Ammunition
abilities.gameEffect: When making a ranged attack, the equipped cog may perform a combat tactic to stun the targeted cog.

abilities.name: Telescopic Binoculars
abilities.gameEffect: Secretly look at the next Artefact card.

abilities.name: Smoke Grenades
abilities.gameEffect: Until the end of this planning phase, the equipped cog and cogs within 2" of it cannot be targeted by ranged attacks or charges.

abilities.name: Anabolic Steroid
abilities.gameEffect: Until the end of the cycle, all standard HP of the equipped cog or an allied cog within 1" of it become reinforced.

abilities.name: Mood Stabiliser
abilities.gameEffect: Remove 2 Darkness tokens from the equipped cog or an allied cog within 1" of it.
